title: Secure container Alpha-1 with TerraGroup evidence

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- If a player dies while having this item in their in-raid quest inventory, it is returned back to them via in-game mail.
- Required for the Terminal transit on Shoreline when doing the Savior ending.
- Required for the "Zubr Boat" extraction on Terminal when doing the Savior ending.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: - Used in the story chapter The Ticket if the player did not refuse to work with Mr. Kerman, assisted him with finding evidence and then continued searching.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: Initially obtained in The Ticket, after handing over 8 Major TerraGroup evidence to Mr. Kerman for the Savior ending.

sections.heading: Terminal
sections.text: On the desk under the window in the armory inside the armory building.
